question: In Google Calendar: Change the description of Kenji Sato's Tokyo-time calendar that has the all-hands on June 21 to "APAC team events". If there isn't one, just tell me.
final:
I checked, but none of the calendars match all three conditions, so I didn't change anything. Here's what I found:

**Kenji Sato's calendars:**
- **"Kenji team"** — his only Tokyo-time (Asia/Tokyo) calendar. It does have an All-hands, but it's on **June 22** (9:00 AM PDT / 1:00 AM JST on the 22nd), not June 21.
- **"Kenji planning"** — has an All-hands on **June 21** (1:00 PM PDT), but this calendar is in **America/Los_Angeles**, not Tokyo time.

(For completeness, the "Tokyo office" calendar also has a June 21 All-hands, but that calendar belongs to Aiko Mori, not Kenji.)

So: no Tokyo-time Kenji calendar with a June 21 all-hands exists. Want me to update "Kenji team" (the Tokyo one) instead, or "Kenji planning" (the one with the June 21 all-hands)?
